definitions.explanation: A person who writes the lyrics (words) for songs, as opposed to the composer who writes the music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{作詞家|さくしか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{作詞家|さくしか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヒット{曲|きょく}→ヒット曲：25764_hittokyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}した→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: She produced numerous hit songs as a lyricist.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作詞家|さくしか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歌詞|かし}→歌詞：13160_kashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the lyricist of this song wrote the lyrics based on personal experience.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{作詞|さくし}→作詞：05233_sakushi⟧ (writing lyrics) and ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional, expert). In the Japanese music industry, ⟦{作詞|さくし}→作詞：05233_sakushi⟧ (lyrics) and ⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧ (composition) are traditionally treated as separate roles, and credits are always listed separately.

USAGE:
- Used to describe someone whose profession or recognized skill is writing song lyrics
- In song credits, you will see ⟦{作詞|さくし}→作詞：05233_sakushi⟧: (lyrics by:) and ⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧: (music by:) listed separately
- Some artists write both lyrics and music — they may be called ⟦シンガーソングライター→シンガーソングライター：27385_shingaasonguraitaa⟧ (singer-songwriter)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作詞家|さくしか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active as a lyricist
- {作詞家|さくしか}⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧: debut as a lyricist
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{作詞家|さくしか}: popular lyricist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作曲家|さっきょくか}: composer — writes the melody and music
- ⟦{作詞|さくし}→作詞：05233_sakushi⟧⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧: lyrics and composition — the combined credit
- ⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧: singer — the performer, not the writer
